note: Family-owned wooded campground on Stoney Creek in Edinburg, in the Shenandoah Valley off I-81, within walking distance of town; 26 W/E/S RV sites (some along the creek) plus water/electric and primitive tent sites; bathhouse with showers, Wi-Fi. Off-creek W/E/S $47.39, creekside $52.65, prime/super sites $57.92-63.18, tax included (rates as posted, undated). RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$42/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.3 over 344 reviews. --Claude
